response.overview: In the shadow of the Acropolis, a revolutionary idea was born that would change history.  Athens: Birth of Democracy takes viewers to ancient Greece, where citizens seized power, challenging kings and tyrants to create democracy. Through discoveries, reenactments, and expert insight, the film reveals how democracy emerged from conflict and innovation, reminding us that this fragile system remains one of humanity’s most radical ideas.
response.title: Athens, Birth of Democracy
